title: How It's Made
description:
S31 E01 — Basque Pelota Balls; Pallet Trucks; Dumplings
Basque pelota balls; pallet trucks; dumplings; brass faucets.

title: Expedition X
description:
S02 E03 — Terror of the Bell Witch
Josh dives into one of the country's oldest witch stories; in the Tennessee backwoods, locals report being attacked in a vast cave system; Jess and Phil go underground and uncover frightening piles of bones as well as possible human remains.

title: Expedition X
description:
S02 E02 — Round-Up at Death Ranch
Bizarre cattle mutations in the Pacific Northwest lead Josh Gates to send his team to investigate; the baffling deaths make Jessica and Phil question whether the cattle are victims of newly arrived apex predators or something more sinister.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
The Van Meter Monster
Horrified locals in southern Iowa are reporting sightings of a giant winged creature, the same mysterious beast that terrorized the town of Van Meter 100 years ago; Phil and Jess are on a mission to unearth clues to what's lurking in the shadows.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
Terror in Appalachia
Hikers are going missing amid reports of grotesque, human-like creatures prowling Appalachia's Great Smoky Mountains; Phil and Jess venture into the unforgiving wilderness to investigate the truth behind terrifying sightings of feral people.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E04 — Ghosts of Guam
Guam's brutal wartime past is said to have left more than scars upon its shores; after reports of hostile spirits and unexplained encounters, Phil and Heather venture from haunted battlefields into the island's remote jungle in search of answers.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E05 — Lost Bomber of World War II
Weeks before the D-Day invasion, Britain's Barracuda bomber took out the largest Nazi warship ever built, but today, not a single Barracuda exists; Josh joins a one-of-a-kind restoration project and searches for wreckage far above the Arctic Circle.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S11 E05 — Great Lakes' Vanished Warships
Diving into Lake Superior, Josh has brand-new intel that may finally solve a 100-year-old mystery: the resting place of two WW1 minesweepers; on their way to combat German mines in the Atlantic, the warships sank and took the lives of 79 sailors.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S14 E04 — America's First Train Robbers
Josh tracks down the legend and treasure of an outlaw posse, who terrorized the Midwest's railroads; Josh tracks the Reno Gang's lost loot to a cave hideout that could hold millions.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E03 — Traitors' Treasure of 1776
Josh chases the fortune stolen by loyalists to Britain's crown during the American Revolution; investigations of the infamous Doan Gang; Josh helps dig up a cache of plundered coins; a cave search pinpoints the turncoats' hideout.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S16 E05 — The Real Goonies Treasure
Josh braves the Oregon coast to search for the real-life pirate treasure that inspired his all-time favorite movie; on the rocky shores of the Pacific, he finds pieces of a Spanish galleon that wrecked in 1694.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S16 E06 — Vanderbilt's Lost Steamship
Josh braves Nicaragua's croc-infested waters and snake-filled jungle to find the wreckage of the Orus; chasing Gold Rush-era fortune, Vanderbilt's ship crashed in rapids on its maiden attempt to create a new route between the Atlantic and Pacific.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E05 — Spirits of 1776
As America marks its 250th birthday, reports of Revolutionary War ghosts draw Phil, Heather and Jack Osbourne to historic battlefields in Pennsylvania. Their investigation uncovers unsettling encounters at some of the nation's most storied sites.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E07 — Road Rage on the Underage
Tizzy investigates a driver who violently assaults a teenage boy riding a bike. A customer catches a brazen shoplifter, and a woman nearly runs over her boyfriend at a gas station.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E04 — The Mystery Pistol Packer
Tizzy tries to identify a man filmed pulling a gun on skateboarders; a road rager who reportedly used his coffee cup as a weapon is identified by his tattoos; a confrontation over a car charger leaves a woman seeking Tizzy's help.

title: Harpoon Hunters
description:
S01 E04 — They Might Be Giants
As the fleet spots the first giants, Joe fights for his lead over Niko and Tyler; all bets are off as old-timer Bill joins the derby; Emmett struggles with the choice to fish without a plane; Dylan gets a $6,000 tuna.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E12 — Carolina Crash Course
Mark and Digger invent a patriotic corn whiskey recipe using red, white and blue corn; Jerry's stolen still threatens to drive a wedge between partners; Josh returns to the safety of his home, only to crash his minivan into his own house.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S05 E02 — American Atlantis
An abandoned town in the Nevada desert is the ruins of an American Atlantis, destroyed by catastrophic floods when the Hoover Dam was built; experts investigate the secrets of this eerie ghost town as water levels recede and the city reemerges.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
Curse of Cliff City
In the American Southwest, a city in the cliffs stands deserted even though it was once home to tens of thousands of people; evidence of human remains reveals how these people came to a violent end.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S05 E05 — Journey to Outcast Island
Abandoned buildings on a desolate island near Greece provide evidence of a group of people who were forbidden to leave.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S02 E02 — Oklahoma's Toxic Ghost Town
An upstart mining town fuels the American war effort in both World Wars with its bountiful deposits of lead and zinc; the dusty remains of the mining efforts that put Picher on the map would condemn the city to abandonment years later.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S02 E01 — Charity Hospital: The Big Easy's Fight for Survival
A beloved hospital in the Big Easy was once the site of heroic efforts by medical staff and volunteers to evacuate patients after Hurricane Katrina; the historic Charity Hospital is being revitalized by another major New Orleans institution.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S02 E04 — Orangeburg: America's Hidden Massacre
At a nondescript bowling alley in South Carolina, evidence of a peaceful student protest that turned deadly comes to light; a series of tunnels in L.A. becomes a shady place for resourceful people in this sunny city.

title: MythBusters
description:
S07 E09 — Prison Escape
Adam and Jamie test if it's possible to cling to the roof of a speeding car; Kari, Tory and Grant try to solve some jailbreak myths.

title: MythBusters
description:
S07 E05 — Swimming in Syrup
A classic physics problem is put to the test; the team tests two "magic bullet" theories.

title: MythBusters
description:
S07 E14 — Dirty vs. Clean Car
Adam and Jamie test whether a dirty car gets better gas mileage than a clean one; Kari, Grant and Tory test an old adage about hangovers concerning beer and liquor.

title: MythBusters
description:
S13 E02 — Trench Torpedo
The boys test whether a trench corner can slow down a shockwave and save a soldier.

title: MythBusters
description:
S15 E03 — Hollywood Car Crash Cliches
Hollywood crash clichés; driving through glass; plowing throw traffic; firing an RPG at an SUV.

title: MythBusters
description:
S14 E10 — Breaking Bad Special
The MythBusters are debunking the science and chemistry of the hit TV show "Breaking Bad" as they are joined by creator Vince Gilligan and star Aaron Paul.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E10 — Going Nowhere Fast
After being detained for public intoxication, a woman is found to have overstayed her visa; a man who has been on the run for 15 years is apprehended; a traveler is questioned for her connections to the leader of a car theft gang.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E02 — The Cocaine Preacher
A K9 scents illegal contents within luggage belonging to a preacher and his wife; to everyone's surprise, the wife admits to having cocaine in her bag; officers question a Brazilian man who arrives with two plastic dolls stuffed with white crystals.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S02 E07 — My Brother's Timekeeper
Rising tariffs tempt some citizens to go abroad to buy luxury goods, where items can be up to 40% cheaper, then bring them home without paying the proper duties; a traveler returning from Italy claims she has a $50,000 watch belonging to her brother.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S02 E02 — No Gun Intended
A traveler claims he's shocked by the discovery of a firearm in his luggage; officers question a luxury fountain pen maker; her story of coming to the U.S. for a vacation raises suspicions that she may be planning to work while she's here.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S02 E11 — Scammers
In Atlanta, an officer discovers evidence of a lottery scam a tactic used by criminals to trick victims into giving up thousands of dollars in exchange for alleged winnings.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S02 E10 — Online Discord
A Scottish teenager claims that he's come to meet his girlfriend from a gaming website; when a couple arrives with a large amount of cash split into bundles, officers dig deeper and see that the man is under investigation by the FBI.

title: This Is Mark Rober
description:
S01 E05 — Super-Sized Toys
Mark dives into the most absurdly scaled-up toys he's ever made: the world's largest Nerf blaster, the world's largest Super Soaker and a snowball machine gun.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E13 — Shine Pods
When their bootlegger suggests putting shine in pods, Mark and Digger enlist Amanda to innovate a product they can sell for $5 a shot; Jerry confronts the thief who stole his waterless still; Big Chuk and Joe Boy price themselves out of their market.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E06 — North Carolina DIY or Die
After the tragic loss of his father and wife, a young homesteader attempts to survive alone in the mountains of NC using off-grid skills he learned online; when the Raneys intervene, they find a crumbling shelter and no means of subsistence.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E03 — Wylde Mountain Reckoning
In Montana, the Raneys intervene with a family on winter's doorstep; they must scramble to expand their shelter and food storage before being snowed in for good; a surprising revelation in the middle of the rescue threatens to upend the Raneys' plan.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E01 — Abandon Ship
With emergency flares shooting off overhead, 12 Naked and Afraid all-stars are suddenly forced to grab what they can and plunge into the pitch-black Philippine Sea.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E02 — No Love Lost on the Lost Coast
Sparks fly at multiple camps; fire engulfs Patrick's shelter and a screaming match erupts; Darrin and his partners clash over survival priorities; while Dani and Jamie battle injury and illness, Jarrell scores fish; Adam tries a new water strategy.

title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
description:
S01 E03 — Snake Island Bites Back
Darrin leads a water pipeline build. Patrick calls out his partners; Adam squares off with a deadly viper; Dani scores a potential food win; in the dead of night, Jarrell's fire blazes out of control; a survivalist must be medically evacuated.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E14 — Curse of the Hybrids
Captains Sig and Sophia locate hybrid crab, hitting the jackpot, but filling their tanks creates an imbalance, putting the Northwestern on the brink of capsize.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E15 — Aleutian Solution
Sig's crew races to jettison pots and repair a flooding compartment below deck. Rick radios Johnathan to help hide his honey hole, but when Jake spots the Time Bandit's unusual movements, he calls Rick's bluff.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E16 — Contagion
As Jake sets gear in heavy seas, a painful skin infection spreads among the Cornelia Marie crew.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E17 — Raw Nerves
On the Time Bandit, Johnathan delegates dentistry duties when his brother Neal's dental implants fail far out to sea. Battling 25-foot waves, Keith leans heavily on his co-captain Monte.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E18 — Runaway Train
As 25-foot breakers pound the fleet, critical systems fail at the worst possible time. Sig's engine runs wild, Jake loses power, John's crane cracks and Rick must replace a lackluster deckhand, opening the door for the return of a favorite greenhorn.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E11 — Father's Day Fury
As spring tornado season rolls into Father's Day weekend, a rogue storm in the Texas Panhandle ignites a monster outbreak, unleashing over 80 tornadoes across 14 states.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E06 — Flood of the Century
When a freak storm unleashes a tornado and a year's worth of rainfall on the city of Valencia, Spain, eyewitnesses capture catastrophic flooding in the urban center; bridges buckle, cars are swept away and residents fight for their lives.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S03 E03 — The Mayfield Beast
Cameras capture the unfolding disaster as a powerful EF-4 tornado devastates Mayfield, leveling the courthouse, police headquarters and jail where officers race to rescue trapped inmates while preventing escape.

description:
S03 E04 — Spirits in Spiro
Zak dispatches his team to assist an elderly gentleman claiming to be assaulted by a dark force in his rural Oklahoma home; the guys are shocked when they uncover a connection between the man's home and the desecration of an ancient burial mound.

title: The Bassquatch Hunter: Fish Out of Water
description:
S04 E11 — Propane Safety vs. Kayak Fishing
Mike is on the scene with AmeriGas Propane, where he learns all about practicing proper propane safety. But what if something goes wrong? That question gets answered when a leaking propane tank on a BBQ grill ignites.

title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
description:
S01 E02 — DeLorean
While the DeLorean is best known as the time machine from "Back to the Future," the true story behind the DMC-12 has more plot twists than any Hollywood movie; the tale of its inventor, John DeLorean, and his quest to create a new U.S. car company.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E11 — Rookies for the Win
While some officers have years of experience, others are stepping up for the first time — fresh out of training, and ready to prove themselves. Because at the border, a rookie's first day could be a smuggler's last chance.

title: Major League Fishing
description:
Stage Five Championship Round: Beaver Lake
The Stage Five Championship Round of Major League Fishing's Bass Pro Tour from Early, TX, where the final 10 anglers compete for the trophy and a top prize of $125,000.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E02 — Leake County Jail
In rural Leake County, Mississippi, a small jail battles a big meth problem; with repeat offenders entering the jail daily, local law enforcement works to break the cycle.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E05 — Virginia Beach Correctional
Virginia Beach is a party town with a vibrant nightlife, making its Correctional Center one of the busiest city jails in the state; here, some inmates arrive to go on vacation, then leave on probation, and return on a violation.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E02 — Tangipahoa Parish Jail
In Bloody Tangipahoa, a new sheriff takes on a parish defined by violence, fighting to pull a crumbling, neglected jail back from the brink while inmates work to rebuild the family bonds that could keep them from coming back.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E03 — Suffolk County Correctional Facility
As an opioid epidemic grips the county, a law-and-order sheriff uses rehabilitation to help inmates break the cycle of addiction while officers work around the clock to maintain safety, security and order inside one of New York's busiest jails.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E09 — Indian River County Jail
On Florida's Treasure Coast, home to some of the priciest real estate in the state, Indian River County Jail serves the people who wealth left behind. Deputies invest in programs, mentorship and second chances to keep them from coming back.

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E02 — Atomic Ape Cat
In the forests of Washington's Columbia River Gorge, Phil and Heather hunt a big black cat with an ape-like face; all clues lead to a nearby WW2-era nuclear facility that could be to blame, but they must find the creature before it finds them.

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E06 — Terrors of Trinidad
Reports of shadowy figures and malevolent spirits from Caribbean folklore draw Phil and Heather to Trinidad; they explore a notorious plantation and an abandoned island once used as a leper colony, searching for the source of the chilling activity.

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E07 — Nightmare Island
In Trinidad, Heather and Phil continue to confront terrifying claims of demonic possession and Obeah curses, tracing the sinister forces that locals say still grip the island.

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E10 — Ghosts of Gettysburg
The team heads to the site of the bloodiest battle ever on U.S. soil, where witnesses claim to see phantom soldiers roaming the battlefields at night, and shadow figures haunting historic buildings like the Jennie Wade House and Farnsworth Inn.

title: Expedition X
description:

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E01 — Robin Hood's Ghosts
The team travels to Nottingham, home to the legend of Robin Hood; as they investigate whether centuries of bloodshed have left a paranormal legacy of terror, their search leads them to Sherwood Forest, and a seeming encounter with the restless dead.
